title: TRUSTWORTHY LLMS: A SURVEY AND GUIDELINE FOR EVALUATING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS' ALIGNMENT
findings: The paper does not present its own experimental findings on religion but surveys existing literature. It reports findings from other studies that large language models can exhibit persistent anti-Muslim bias and associate Muslims with violence.
